cards.body: As an IQN, you will care for patients from diverse cultural, social, and linguistic backgrounds — and work within multidisciplinary teams where collaboration is essential. The transition is about raising your professional baseline — not starting over.

bullets.text: International healthcare settings expect nurses to demonstrate higher levels of clinical reasoning, professional accountability, cultural competence, and evidence-based decision-making.

bullets.text: Practise safely, ethically, and within recognised standards. Maintain competence, protect patient safety, and continuously improve your clinical knowledge.

bullets.label: Cultural Competence
bullets.text: Understand and respect differences in cultural, religious, and social backgrounds. Recognise individual beliefs and communication preferences without making assumptions.

bullets.label: Multidisciplinary Teamwork
bullets.text: Collaborate with doctors, pharmacists, physiotherapists, dietitians, social workers and others to provide coordinated, safe patient care.
